title: Spicy Udon Noodle Stir Fry
description: A keto-friendly and spicy stir-fry featuring udon noodles, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the spicy miso paste, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the spicy miso paste mixture over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the scallions and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked udon noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the spicy sauce.
Optional: Garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
